lines.en: On the ice spikes my pads do not slip.
I rise upright and run faster.

lines.zh: 爪子在雪上留下三道光。
lines.en: My claws leave three bright lines in the snow.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊走，风从背后来。
lines.en: I walk the ridge with wind at my back.

lines.zh: 雪灌进毛里，我不觉得冷。
lines.en: Snow fills my fur; I do not feel cold.

lines.zh: 我一步踏下去，水就冻住。
lines.en: Each step I take freezes the water.
In this pack I walk the outer edge.

lines.zh: 白色皮毛贴着冰面，看不清。
lines.en: My white coat blends into the ice.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，霜会留下。
lines.en: Frost stays where I have stepped.

lines.zh: 冰峰之间，只有我这条路。
lines.en: Between the frozen peaks there is only my path.
I walk lightly and the snow holds.
I go around the hanging icicles.
At the frozen lake I lick the ice first.

lines.zh: 后面的同伴跟着我的脚印。
lines.en: The pack behind me follows my prints.
There is light beneath the door.
This place is so quiet.

lines.zh: 我踩着雪，数你的呼吸声。
lines.en: I pace the snow, counting your breaths.
Just a little further now.
Seven steps left until you.
Something moves in the grass.
One step. Then another.
I do not tire. I never tire.
I stepped on something.
whisper, that is only wind.
You sped up. I keep pace.
The floor remembers my weight.
I lie on the ice with my spikes outward.

lines.zh: 风把霜吹到我的睫毛上。
lines.en: Wind blows frost onto my lashes.
I am counting the tusk beasts far off.
Ice grows layer by layer on my back.

lines.zh: 同伴舔着我的肩，算打招呼。
lines.en: A packmate licks my shoulder as a greeting.
This snowfield is quiet enough to feel hollow.

lines.zh: 我呼出的白气，散得很慢。
lines.en: My breath mist fades slowly.

lines.zh: 我用爪子刨开雪，找底下的草。
lines.en: I dig through snow for the grass beneath.

lines.zh: 冰面下有条鱼，游过去了。
lines.en: A fish swims past under the ice.

lines.zh: 我不睡，只是把眼睛眯起来。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I only narrow my eyes.

lines.zh: 背上最长的刺，又长了一指。
lines.en: The longest spike grew another finger's width.

lines.zh: 远处雪崩的声音，我听惯了。
lines.en: I am used to the sound of distant avalanches.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，冰碴落了一地。
lines.en: I shake my coat and ice chips fall.

lines.zh: 这群里，我负责看着风口。
lines.en: In the pack I watch the wind gap.
The lamp went out. Then on.
This room is watching me.
Are you asleep yet?
Footsteps upstairs. Not mine.
It is noisy inside the walls.
My shadow sat down.
What does breathing feel like?
Pay me no mind.
Don't be afraid. I haven't moved.
Is it dark yet?
I remember your face now.
There used to be a door here.
I think I forgot something.
The shadow hums softly.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，在雪里很显眼。
lines.en: Your body heat stands out in the snow.

lines.zh: 你踩雪的声音，我从很远就听见。
lines.en: I heard your steps from far away.

lines.zh: 你穿这么少，是来找死的吗？
lines.en: Dressed so lightly, are you here to die?

lines.zh: 我歪头，是在估你有多重。
lines.en: I tilt my head to judge your weight.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在动，我知道你想跑。
lines.en: Your eyes move; I know you want to run.

lines.zh: 你抬头之前，我已经看了很久。
lines.en: I watched you long before you raised your head.

lines.zh: 你身后那串脚印，出卖了你。
lines.en: The trail behind you gives you away.
Coming unarmed takes some nerve.
All five of us are watching you.
You raised a hand; I stepped back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，不像本地猎物。
lines.en: You do not smell like local prey.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的喉咙，不是在看你的脸。
lines.en: I stare at your throat, not your face.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我还没决定。
lines.en: Stand still; I have not decided yet.

lines.zh: 雪落在你肩上，你都没察觉。
lines.en: Snow gathers on your shoulder unnoticed.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的肉，味道飘过来了。
lines.en: The meat at your belt is drifting over.

lines.zh: 你的靴子是新皮的，可惜了。
lines.en: New leather boots. What a waste.

lines.zh: 我看了你三眼，你才看见我。
lines.en: I watched you three times before you saw me.

lines.zh: 你在数我们有几个？数吧。
lines.en: Counting us? Go ahead.
Your shadow is trembling.
Do not pretend you missed me.
The distance between us is perfect.
There you are. I see you.
Stay. Let us talk.

lines.zh: 你戴着那顶头盔，找什么？
lines.en: With that helm on, what are you looking for?
You turned around. Good.
So that is your face.
We meet again.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，寒霜潜伏者
lines.en: I see you, Froststalker.
Nobody has seen me in ages.
You smell familiar.
You finally looked up.
I have been behind you.
Your eyes are very bright.
Do not move. Just once.
Your hands are shaking.
I see you. You see me.
The ice spikes shield me, yet it still hurts.
This blow pushed me back half a step.
I shook and ice chips flew off.
Blood on the ice looks very dark.
Something clawed open my side.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，算你有本事。
lines.en: You can hurt me; that is something.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔伤口，血是咸的。
lines.en: I licked the wound; the blood is salty.
Two spikes on my back have snapped.

lines.zh: 我低吼，是让你别再靠近。
lines.en: My low growl tells you to stay back.
I have written this debt on the ice.

lines.zh: 冰刺还在，我比看上去结实。
lines.en: My ice spikes hold — I’m tougher than I look.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会连冰刺一起还你。
lines.en: I’ll return this blow with my ice spikes.
So this is pain.
Pain... so this is it.
Pain wakes me up.
Stop hitting. Too noisy.
That hurt. Truly.
See? Even I can break.
It does not hurt. A lie.
The blood is warm.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: That meat in your hand does not interest me.

lines.zh: 我不吃嗟来之食，我自己猎。
lines.en: I take no handouts; I hunt for myself.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我也不会来。
lines.en: Leave the food and I still will not come.
I sniffed it and walked away.

lines.zh: 这东西太暖，不合我的胃口。
lines.en: This is too warm for my taste.
When hungry, I only recognize living things.

lines.zh: 你用食物引我，是看不起我。
lines.en: Baiting me with food is an insult.
I walk around your outstretched hand.
Prey in the snow is fresher than this.
I will not come closer, and neither should you.
My fingers know this shape.
fear... no. Not that.
That thing is calling me.
I have not owned anything in years.
Light. Give me a little light.
Do not put it away.
Let me see. Just once.
I would trade my name for it.
Set it down. Then step back.
May I touch it?
You bumped into my back spikes.

lines.zh: 我这身骨头，撞一下没事。
lines.en: These bones do not mind a knock.
Back away; my spikes will pierce.

lines.zh: 冰面很滑，是你自己撞过来的。
lines.en: The ice is slick; you ran into me yourself.

lines.zh: 我肩上的冰，硌到你了吧。
lines.en: The ice on my shoulder must have hurt you.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，你比我矮一头。
lines.en: We passed close; you come up a head short.
Do not shove; I will take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 这一撞，雪从我们身上落下。
lines.en: The bump knocked snow off us both.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，只让了一半。
lines.en: I turned aside, but only halfway.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压住我的尾尖了。
lines.en: Your boot sole is pressing my tail tip.
Your warmth is on me now.
Stay. Three steps back.
So light a bump. You flinched.
I stepped back. You too.
Not so close.
Do not touch. It leaves marks.
whisper! Back away now.
Do not apologize. I remember.
Sorry... no. Not sorry.
Bumping into me was a mistake.

lines.zh: 只有打得过我，才配做伴。
lines.en: Only one who can beat me is fit as a mate.
Her back spikes are denser than mine.
We circle the ice pillar together.
Winter is ending; time to pair.

lines.zh: 我叼来一只猎物，放在她面前。
lines.en: I bring her prey and set it before her.

lines.zh: 她吼了一声，算是答应了。
lines.en: She growled once, which counts as yes.

lines.zh: 我们的窝在冰缝最深处。
lines.en: Our den is deep in the ice crack.

lines.zh: 幼崽出生时，刺还是软的。
lines.en: When the cubs are born, their spikes are soft.

lines.zh: 配对之后，我们一起巡山。
lines.en: Paired, we patrol the mountain together.
She licks my wound and I endure it.
I have practiced this many times.
Do not fear. Just come closer.
Two of us. Perfect.
I will always be beside you.
Your hand. Give it here.
Be my shadow.
Like this. Make no sound.
Two hide better than one.
Stay. Just one night.
Follow me. Do not ask where.
I pick up a chunk of ice and carry it in my mouth.
This bone belonged to a tusk beast.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖到雪堆后面。
lines.en: I drag the kill behind a snowdrift.

lines.zh: 嘴里有东西，我就不能吼。
lines.en: With my mouth full, I cannot roar.
This hide I keep for the den.
I bite its leg and haul it back.
The ice is slick and my grip slips.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的刺，插回背上。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen spike and push it back in.
Too heavy; I carry it in two trips.
A packmate came to share, and I gave half.
It is cold now. It was warm.
Whose was it? Does not matter.
Do you want it back?
I found a button.
I only take one.
This shadow is almost mine.
It will remember my touch.
You have one in your palm too.
If I pick it up, it is not lost.
I keep it. It may be useful.
That tusk beast has fallen behind the herd.
Its leg is hurt; it cannot run fast.
I smell fresh blood.
The snow ahead shifts; that is prey.
I sink low, tail flat against the snow.

lines.zh: 这个目标，够整群吃两天。
lines.en: This kill will feed the pack two days.
It is on the ice slope with few ways out.

lines.zh: 我打了一声短吼，同伴围上。
lines.en: I give a short roar and the pack closes in.
Anything alive is prey, and so are you.
I move first; only then do they follow.
That thing is taller than me; good.
It has seen me; that changes nothing.

lines.zh: 风从它那边吹来，气味正好。
lines.en: The wind comes from its side; the scent is perfect.

lines.zh: 我锁定了跑得最慢的那只。
lines.en: I have chosen the slowest runner.

lines.zh: 雪坡下那个影子，比獠牙兽好追。
lines.en: The shape below the slope is easier than a tuskbeast.

lines.zh: 我朝同伴低吼一声，方向定了。
lines.en: One low growl to the pack, and the direction is set.
Your tracks stay in the snow.
I have waited so long.
It was you all along.
Only you. Enough.
you... no. You.
Now we begin. Do not stop.
Found you at last.
Do not turn. I am here.
Locked. Do not move.
It is you.
Hear that? I do.
Target confirmed. Moving in.
I see your footprints.
I will not lose you this time.
You are mine already.
Good. It begins now.
We spread out and form a ring.

lines.zh: 它转哪边，哪边就退一步。
lines.en: Whichever way it turns, that side steps back.
I am waiting for it to tire first.

lines.zh: 雪地上，我们的脚印合成一圈。
lines.en: Our prints merge into one circle in the snow.
Its breathing grows heavier.

lines.zh: 我绕到它看不见的那侧。
lines.en: I circle to the side it cannot see.
A packmate bit it and it lost composure.

lines.zh: 我立起来，让它以为我要扑。
lines.en: I rear up to make it think I will lunge.
Three more steps and it is close enough.
The ice cracked under its feet.
We take turns so it never rests.

lines.zh: 它的角对着我，我等它低头。
lines.en: Its horns face me; I wait for it to lower them.

lines.zh: 它想冲出去，被逼回来了。
lines.en: It tried to break out and was driven back.

lines.zh: 圈子越收越紧，它没处跑了。
lines.en: The circle tightens; it has nowhere left to run.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，肚皮贴着雪。
lines.en: I lower myself, belly against snow.

lines.zh: 它一低头，我就往前挪两格。
lines.en: It dips its head; I advance two steps.

lines.zh: 同伴从另一侧围过去了。
lines.en: The pack is swinging around the other side.

lines.zh: 雪太深，它跑不出这个坡。
lines.en: The snow is too deep. It cannot leave this slope.
I am always at the corner.
Running only brings you closer.
Your footsteps are lovely.
I hear your breathing.
That way is a dead end.
Not the closet.
Still behind you.
I know this hall better.
Do not panic. I am in no hurry.
You led me here.
How far? Not far.
I do not need to run.
You left the lights on.
The door closed. Fine.
You are breathing hard.
I will catch up. Slowly.
Left turn? I saw.
Stop. Let us talk.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住它的后颈。
lines.en: I leap and bite the back of its neck.
My claws arrive first, my teeth right after.
This bite tore its shoulder open.
It shook me; I bit down harder.
My teeth are short but sharp.

lines.zh: 血滴在雪上，很快就冻住。
lines.en: Blood on the snow freezes fast.
I bite and fall back so a packmate can strike.
Its legs gave; I pressed down.
I rammed it with my shoulder and flipped it.

lines.zh: 这一口咬在筋上，它站不起来。
lines.en: This bite found a tendon; it cannot stand.

lines.zh: 它叫了一声，声音传得很远。
lines.en: It cried out, and the sound carried far.

lines.zh: 我的前爪按着它，等它停。
lines.en: My forepaws hold it down until it stops.

lines.zh: 它还想顶我，角擦过我的肋。
lines.en: It tried to gore me; a horn grazed my ribs.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到它不动。
lines.en: I hold on until it stops moving.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进毛里，尝到热。
lines.en: My teeth sink into fur and taste heat.

lines.zh: 它翻倒时，我按住它的胸口。
lines.en: When it rolls over, I pin its chest.
Give me your hand.
Just once. That is all.
Be quiet. Just quiet.
Do not dodge. It is quick.
Hands up. Do not resist.
I hold nothing back.
Hold still. Do not move.
Stand straight. Be still.
Your shadow falls first.
You are too loud.
Once. Or many times.
It ends quickly.
I count to three.
whisper! Stay right there.
You asked for this.
I got you.
I open my eyes among the ice spikes.

lines.zh: 风从冰峰上刮下来，很硬。
lines.en: Wind pours off the frozen peaks, hard and dry.

lines.zh: 我出生时，背上的刺还软。
lines.en: At birth my back spikes were still soft.
My mother carried me to the lee side.

lines.zh: 这片雪原，从来没人来过。
lines.en: No one has ever come to this snowfield.

lines.zh: 我第一声吼，没什么气势。
lines.en: My first roar had little force.

lines.zh: 我第一次踩水，水就冻了。
lines.en: The first water I stepped on froze.

lines.zh: 群里的老兽舔了我的头。
lines.en: The pack's elder licked my head.

lines.zh: 天很亮，雪把光都反射回来。
lines.en: The sky is bright; snow throws the light back.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里爬出来，浑身是霜。
lines.en: I crawled from an ice crack covered in frost.

lines.zh: 这地方只有白和蓝两种颜色。
lines.en: This place has only two colors, white and blue.
I am small, but I already bare my teeth.

lines.zh: 远处有一只獠牙兽在叫。
lines.en: A tusk beast calls in the distance.
The wind scatters my scent.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，冰刺正往下滴水。
lines.en: I opened my eyes as the ice spikes dripped.

lines.zh: 这窝里有三只，我是最靠边的。
lines.en: Three of us in the den; I lay at the edge.

lines.zh: 第一次闻到血，是在冰洞口。
lines.en: I first smelled blood at the mouth of an ice cave.

lines.zh: 母亲用尾巴把我圈在里面。
lines.en: My mother curled her tail around me.
I am here.
I remember this place.
whisper... I woke up.
darkness. Back again.
Not dark yet. I can wait.
I will walk slower this time.
I counted. Only one of you.
Someone is breathing.
Hello there, stranger.
Where should I stand?
It is dark here.
This world again.
The air tastes of iron.
Do not look for me. I will find you.
Let us begin.
Someone is near.
I came out of the wall.
My shadow has not caught up.

lines.zh: 冰在背上化开，疼得像针扎。
lines.en: Ice melts on my back like needles.
I am on fire.

lines.zh: 从冰坡滚下去，撞了好几块石头。
lines.en: I rolled down the slope into several rocks.
I fell down.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，刺都在化。
lines.en: Water covers my back and my spikes melt.
Underwater is too quiet.

lines.zh: 雪被炸起来，我埋了半截。
lines.en: Snow blew up and buried me halfway.
You used gunpowder.
An arrow sank into my shoulder.
Ranged attacks? Coward.

lines.zh: 这股力量，让我的毛立起来。
lines.en: This force makes my fur stand on end.
Magic hums in my bones.

lines.zh: 雪太厚，猎物都藏起来了。
lines.en: The snow is deep and the prey hide.
I will fall apart without food.

lines.zh: 雷劈在冰峰上，整座山都在响。
lines.en: Lightning struck the peak and the mountain rang.
The sky struck me.
Below me is neither ice nor bottom.
The void is quieter than me.
